decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted numbered PL-864-01, -02, -03, -04, -05, -06A and Design & Access Statement Received 27/07/2010 and Amended plans PL-864-01B and PL-863-04B Received 28/09/2010  therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 5 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until a scheme for soundproofing of the Workshops, including samples of materials for the external finishing of Workshop 2 have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details

Condition : 6 - The use hereby permitted for MOT testing purposes shall not be carried on outside the following times: 08:00-18:00 Monday-Friday, 09:00-17:00 Saturday nor at any time on Sundays, Bank or Public Holidays.

Condition : 7 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the arrangements for on-site storage of waste and recycled materials have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority. The arrangements for storing waste and recycled materials shall not be carried out otherwise than in accordance with any approval given and shall be completed before any part of the accommodation hereby permitted is occupied.  No waste shall be stored on site other than within the designated storage areas.

Condition : 8 - Before first occupation of the buildings the loading, unloading and turning space, and parking spaces (including space for people with disabilities) shall be provided within the curtilage of the site in accordance with the scheme shown on drawing PL-864-01B and such spaces shall be permanently available and not be used for any other purpose (including any additional external storage).  No less than five of these spaces, including at least one for use by disablde drivers, shall be made permanently available for customers of the MOT testing service.

Condition : 9 - No development shall take place until details of a Sustainable Urban Drainage Scheme, including measures for (i) the harvesting of rainwater, (ii) the minimisation of water run-off from the site, in accordance with the submitted Flood Risk Assessment, and (iii) the conservation and reuse as appropriate of other water supplies in the buildings have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.  These details shall be carried out as approved prior to occupation of the buildings unless otherwise approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority and retained and maintained thereafter.
Condition : 10 - Car repairs, maintenance or testing shall not be carried out on site other than within an existing building.
Condition : 11 - No sales of cars shall take place on or from the premises.

Condition : 12 - The use hereby permitted shall not be begun until details of the boundary treatment and traffic calming measures to be located within 10m of the site entrance have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details
description: Incorporation of MOT testing facilities into existing workshop and erection of collapsable gates.
